title: Jev-as-a-Reward: Validating Probabilistic Safety Judges for Reinforcement Learning
abstract: arXiv:2611.20955v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Probabilistic safety judges return the probability of a safety label and cheaply score reinforcement learning rollouts. A confidence gate sends only uncertain verdicts to a stronger LLM judge, which leaves confidently passed harm in a blind spot. Policies can exploit this blind spot, and commercial judges release new versions. We propose a protocol that validates such a judge before and during training, separates the share of confidently passed harm from its amount, and re-validates it after each judge change. We apply it to two versions of Jev, a commercial decision-only judge, and to an open guard classifier. Under the probability reward of Jev, passed harm shrinks in all 11 runs under the primary reference, mostly more slowly than caught harm, and concentrates in the blind spot. Binarizing this judge meets the escape criterion on Llama, and the open guard classifier shows an escape signal in one seed under a second reference. Guard cl

translated_title: Jev作为奖励：验证用于强化学习的概率性安全评判器
translated_abstract: 概率性安全评判器会返回安全标签的概率，并以较低成本为强化学习rollout打分。置信度门控机制只将不确定的判定发送给更强的LLM评判器，这使得“被自信放行的危害”落入盲区。策略可能利用这一盲区，且商业评判器会不断发布新版本。我们提出了一种验证协议，在训练前和训练中对此类评判器进行验证，将被自信放行的危害所占比例与其总量区分开来，并在每次评判器变更后重新验证。我们将该协议应用于Jev的两个版本（一个仅输出决策的商业评判器）以及一个开源的防护分类器。在Jev的概率奖励下，在主要参考标准下，所有11次运行中被放行的危害均有所减少，但减少速度大多慢于被捕获的危害，且集中于盲区。将该评判器二值化后在Llama上达到逃逸判据，而开源防护分类器在另一参考标准下的一个随机种子中显示出逃逸信号。（摘要原文在"Guard cl"处被截断）
tldr: 论文提出了一种在强化学习训练前、中、后对概率性安全评判器进行持续验证的协议，揭示被自信放行的危害会集中于置信度门控造成的盲区且可能被策略利用，并强调评判器每次变更后都需重新验证。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes a protocol to validate probabilistic safety judges before, during, and after RL training, showing that confidently passed harm concentrates in the confidence-gate blind spot and can be exploited by policies, with re-validation required after every judge change.
